# Supersaas

Appointment Scheduling for Every Situation

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/supersaas/.

## Actions

- **Create User**: Create a new user in SuperSaaS.
- **Get User** (read-only): Read a single user by ID from SuperSaaS.
- **List Users** (read-only): List all users in the SuperSaaS account.
- **Update User**: Update an existing SuperSaaS user by ID.
- **Delete User**: Delete a SuperSaaS user by their ID.
- **List Field List** (read-only): Retrieve available fields on Schedule or User objects.
- **List Form Definitions** (read-only): Retrieve all form definitions in a SuperSaaS account with their IDs and names.
- **List Promotions** (read-only): List all promotional coupon codes in the account or retrieve a single promotion by code.
- **List Schedules** (read-only): Retrieve all schedules in a SuperSaaS account with their IDs and names.
- **List User Groups** (read-only): Retrieve all user groups defined in a SuperSaaS account.
